item.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
item.description: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.

item.title: DBrand knocked it out of the park with its Nintendo Switch 2 Killswitch protective gear, and after testing it, I might just keep it on my console forever
item.description: The DBrand Killswitch is one of the best protective options for your Nintendo Switch 2, but is it truly worth its asking price?

item.title: Is there any benefit to keeping your smart TV in standby mode?
item.description: A Smart TV doesn't just sit idle when you push the power button on your remote. They're designed to perform a number of important tasks without you realising.
